provenance_note: The isolated gateway ran Kiro Crew at the App Kit level-1 seams commit from a throwaway checkout in which the built-in PPTX Maker no longer registers (pptx_maker taken out of BUILTIN_NAMES, its app.json and its core pptx-maker skill removed) but its Python package stays importable, because today the gateway renders this app's agent templates from that package (PORTING.md gap 1). This repository was installed from a clean clone of the commit named in app_commit, trusted and enabled through the dashboard API, and its engine and icon packs were installed through the app's own routes. LibreOffice 26.8.2 (the official Linux build, unpacked, not installed) was on PATH so the engine could draw the slide previews; the managed pdftoppm was installed after the agents were registered, so the agent's own preview check could not use it (it says so in its reply). The live chat was switched to the per-chat Trust approval mode through the chat's own approval-mode menu; the gateway's default stayed 'reads'.
data_notes: Every person, place, number and address in the demo deck is made up; the e-mail address uses the reserved .example domain.

The deck was written by the live agent in the use-case-vibe scene, from the pasted notes in capture/scenes.json, into a demo deck folder (/tmp/pptx-maker-demo/decks, set through the app's Settings route); the later screenshots and the walkthrough show that same deck. Its folder name carries the capture date.
The eight styles and two templates are the ones the pinned engine ships.

steps.value:
Turn this into a five-slide deck for our volunteers. Keep it friendly, with a fresh green look.

Harbor Lane Community Garden: spring update
- 42 raised beds this season, up from 30 last year; 8 of the new beds are wheelchair height.
- Our rain barrels now catch about 3,000 litres a month, enough to water the herb rows all summer.
- Saturday work mornings run 9 to 11 am. Tools are in the blue shed; gloves are in the bin by the gate.
- The seed library has 120 packets: take two, and bring seeds back in the autumn.
- Next goals: a shade pergola by June, and a compost class on 14 May.
- Questions: hello@harborlane-garden.example

screenshots.alt: A Vibe mode chat on the pptx-maker-vibe agent, set to Trust: the pasted garden notes are collapsed at the top, and the agent's reply says the five-slide deck is ready at its output.pptx path, that it could not look at the slides as pictures because the preview tool is missing on this machine, lists the five slides (Title, Growth, Saturdays, Seed library, What's next) with what each shows, says the look is light and green with garden icons and speaker notes, and lists four friendly lines it added that are not in the notes; buttons offer 'Looks good, I'm done', 'Remove the extra friendly lines' and 'Make the green brighter'

steps.caption: PPTX Maker: decks an agent built from a chat
Each slide is drawn here as the agent composes it
The brief, the outline and the art direction come first
Pick a style, then paste its token into the chat
Templates are .pptx files that set the layouts and theme colours
Vibe mode opens a chat on the app's own agent: paste your notes and send
